response.sql: WITH race_name_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps FROM results AS res JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId GROUP BY r.name), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS average_total FROM race_name_totals) SELECT SUM(t.total_points) AS sum_points, AVG(t.average_laps) AS average_laps, AVG(t.total_points - b.average_total) AS average_excess FROM race_name_totals AS t CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE t.total_points > b.average_total;
